guest_evidence: HP VUE 2.01 resources and man pages read from the SR10.4 guest; Swiss 742 bold 12pt system font; primary color set 3, secondary menus set 4 with application overrides

gtk3_scrollbar_relief.normal: Direction-specific integer triangle; light upper/left, shadow lower/right. Orient silhouette before applying light.
gtk3_scrollbar_relief.pressed: Exchange light and shadow while held; preserve silhouette; release restores normal relief.

color_policy.primary_relief: Light/dark derived from the current Window or Button face
color_policy.secondary_relief: Light/dark derived from the current Header or Selection face
color_policy.inset_view: KDE View face/text with enclosing Window color-set shadows
color_policy.marked_check_radio: Select-color interior relative to the Button face and reversed relief

adaptations: KDE has one shared application palette, rather than eight per-client VUE color sets; Vuefile, Vuehelp and Vuestyle used distinct secondary sets
KDE list/text selection keeps the exported Selection role; native VUE XmList could use foreground/background reverse video
GTK3 TreeView does not paint the main CSS frame for its populated scrollable body; no per-cell shadow, widget wrapper or toolkit patch is used to imitate it
Modern GTK controls absent in VUE are drawn with the same square two-pixel relief
GTK4 has no native scrollbar arrow buttons
No proprietary font is distributed; application fonts remain KDE/user settings
excluded: HP bitmaps, fonts, binaries or source code
